subject: Helios Cloud AP onboarding: payment cadence, PO flow, and early-pay pilot
messages:
From: Claire DuPont <claire@helioscloud.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Apr 2028 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: New vendor onboarding — AP questions and early-pay request

Hi Mina,

Thanks again for walking us through Redwood’s onboarding checklist last week. We’re excited to get PO flow and invoicing live. Two quick items from our AP team before we start submitting invoices:

1) Preferred payment cadence: we typically invoice on the 1st of each month and get paid Net 45. Is Net 45 compatible with Redwood’s default vendor cadence, or do you prefer Net 30/Net 60?

2) Early-pay option: our CFO has proposed an early-pay discount pilot (1.25% if paid within 10 days). Would Redwood consider a short pilot for Q2? We’d like to test faster cash processing.

I’ve cc’d accounts-payable@helioscloud.com for anything they want to add. We can share sample invoices and a filled onboarding form if that helps.

Best,
Claire DuPont
Head of Finance Operations
Helios Cloud

Attachments: sample_invoice_helios_march.pdf (stub)

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Claire DuPont <claire@helioscloud.com>, accounts-payable@helioscloud.com
Date: Mon, 9 Apr 2028 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: New vendor onboarding — AP questions and early-pay request

Team — forwarding Helios’ note. Quick thoughts:

- Helios prefers Net45 and is asking about a 1.25% / 10-day early-pay pilot.
- They can provide sample invoices and onboarding forms; asked for their PO flow details.

Ben — can we run numbers on unit economics for a margin on early-pay (1.25% @ 10D) and whether we can operationalize payment within 10 days without manual overhead?

Karthik — if Finance is open, I’d like Procurement to add this to our Q2 early-pay pilot roster. We should decide: accept Net45 as standard AND offer early-pay as an opt-in incentive OR require Net30 if vendor opts into early-pay.

Marissa — you own the relationship; can you confirm whether Helios needs a single PO per month or per-invoice POs? That affects our AP routing. Also, please request their W9 and preferred remit address.

Thanks — Mina
Director, Vendor Ops
Redwood Inference

Attachments: (none)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Claire DuPont <claire@helioscloud.com>, accounts-payable@helioscloud.com
Date: Mon, 9 Apr 2028 12:46:00 -0700
Subject: Re: New vendor onboarding — AP questions and early-pay request

Mina / team — quick finance read:

- 1.25% / 10D early-pay is attractive if we can automate remittance through our AP portal. Gross-cost vs. time value suggests Net45 vs. Net30 difference: paying at 10 days for a 1.25% discount is roughly equivalent to ~3.7% annualized — inexpensive relative to cheaper cash alternatives, but operational complexity matters.

Action items for me to sign off:
- Confirm Helios’ typical invoice timing (single monthly invoice vs. per-project).
- Confirm ACH details and whether they can accept our payment file format (ISO20022/CSV).
- Verify there are no SOW milestones that require partial invoicing which complicate the PO flow.

If they send a sample invoice and onboarding form I’ll run a quick pilot model. If they want the early-pay pilot, we should scope it to 2 months (start of May) with a cap (e.g., up to $100k) so risk is bounded.

-Ben
Sr. Finance Manager | Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Claire DuPont <claire@helioscloud.com>, accounts-payable@helioscloud.com
Date: Tue, 10 Apr 2028 10:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: New vendor onboarding — AP questions and early-pay request

Claire / Helios — thanks for outlining. A few procurement notes and a proposed onboarding cadence: 

- Default: Redwood’s vendor policy supports Net30 or Net45 depending on negotiated terms. For strategic vendors, Net45 is acceptable but we require a signed PO and vendor profile completion before first payment.
- Early-pay offer: we’re open to an opt-in pilot. Proposal: Net45 standard; Helios can opt into an early-pay program for a 1.25% discount if invoices are loaded by EOD and paid within 10 calendar days. Pilot term: 60 days, cap $100k, Redwood will evaluate operational load and approval hit rate.
- PO flow options:
  * Single monthly PO: appropriate if Helios sends 1 consolidated invoice per month.
  * Per-invoice PO: required if invoices map to different SOWs/projects.

Please provide: a sample invoice (line-item detail), the onboarding form (I can review fields), ACH/ACH + remit instructions, and preferred PO terms.

If procurement signs off, we’ll add Helios to the early-pay pilot in our onboarding queue; finance will provision a vendor code and we’ll route payments through our AP file process.

—Karthik
Head of Procurement | Redwood Inference

From: Claire DuPont <claire@helioscloud.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Apr 2028 15:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: New vendor onboarding — AP questions and early-pay request

Thanks, everyone — this is great. Per requests, attached are: Helios_Onboarding_Form_v3.pdf (filled), sample_invoice_helios_april.pdf, and ACH_remit_instructions.txt. Helios prefers a single consolidated invoice on the 1st of each month (so single monthly PO would be ideal).

We’re happy to join the 60-day early-pay pilot with the 1.25% / 10-day option and the $100k cap you proposed. Please confirm:

- Redwood will issue the PO and vendor code before May 1.
- We can receive payments by ACH; we accept Redwood’s standard payment file.
- DocuSign: we can sign onboarding paperwork — send the DocuSign link.

Looking forward to getting this live.

Best,
Claire DuPont
Head of Finance Operations
Helios Cloud

Attachments: Helios_Onboarding_Form_v3.pdf (stub), sample_invoice_helios_april.pdf (stub), ACH_remit_instructions.txt (stub)
